heading: Meet Your Tutor
body:
Liza Smith has been professionally grooming since 2000 and combines more than 26 years of industry experience with qualifications in teaching, assessment and dog behaviour. She has trained and supported aspiring groomers at every stage, from complete beginners to experienced professionals looking to refine their technique.

Liza’s aim is not simply to help students pass a qualification. She wants them to understand dogs, work safely, build genuine confidence and leave with skills they can use in the real world. Her practical, encouraging approach has helped many former students go on to build successful careers and businesses of their own.
